name: Filters Log Group
description: A CloudWatch Logs metric filter or subscription filter acts on the events of one log group (filter -> log group): the group's ARN, built from the filter's log group name and the run's partition, region and account (the form the log group node is keyed by). A reference, not containment. Emitted whether or not the log group was collected: it resolves by deterministic identity when it is.
